plan: same seven annotation-exposure-v1 pairs, fourteen 200-frame windows; all forty identities retained
period: oracle pre/post nominal BPM from the selected adjacent constant segments; supplied to both window roles and all hypotheses, never estimated from packets
phase: four prior annotation anchors, oldest to newest, transported by nominal pre-period to the last prefix beat ordinal; no best-phase selection or averaging
step_boundary: annotated change time relative to the change window, translated to the identical elapsed position in the constant control
hypotheses: constant and phase-continuous step, each at native, half phase zero, half phase one and double density
geometry: correct native hypothesis must agree within the unchanged inclusive three-frame radius with every full-query annotation ordinal and vice versa at each of four phases, in both pair members; no nearest-tick remapping; failures remain but cannot support discrimination conclusions
ownership: unchanged whole-capture packets, half-open windows, both sources kept separate; no crop-local extraction
eligibility: a budget/support rejection on any member, source, phase or clock suppresses both pair ledgers; no replacement; geometry failures are reported separately
ledger: unchanged rational maximum cardinality then minimum distance, all optimal assignments, three-frame radius
marks: beat and downbeat logit signs strictly above zero; negatives are not calibrated absence evidence; downbeat annotation placeholders are not labels
positive_match_bounds: for each head count always-matched positive packets as lower bound and all possibly-matched positive packets as upper bound; conservative bounds, not necessarily jointly attainable extrema or probabilities
dominance: clock A has no fewer matches, no more unmatched ticks, and lower positive-match bounds for both heads >= B upper bounds, with at least one strict guaranteed axis; exact degenerate equality otherwise equal, all remaining cases unresolved
context: native constant/step response-state cross-tab by shared pre/post boundary, full-query/boundary response location, and paired-head sign, across all assignment optima
decision: per source, both true native roles must dominate the opposite native shape at all four phases; additionally true native must dominate all seven competing shape/density clocks at every phase to be density-resolved; any eligible failure forbids promoting this count/sign selector, not every conceivable model feature
independence: seven calibration tracks are not generalization evidence; a positive result requires new independent labeled examples
